name: @teasel/parser
description: A JavaScript and TypeScript parser in Rust. It answers in ESTree.

scripts.build:js: tsc --ignoreConfig src/native.ts src/wasm.ts src/plan.ts --outDir dist --rootDir src --declaration --erasableSyntaxOnly --strict --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --lib es2022,dom --types node --skipLibCheck
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release -p teasel-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && node scripts/wasm.ts
scripts.test: npm run build:js && node scripts/test.ts && node scripts/test.ts interpret
